observations.rest: Exact textured source cast loads with coherent framing, lighting, and material identity.
observations.smooth: C, S, and asymmetric poses preserve the whole-body silhouette, belly continuity, dorsal plates, texture, and attached radial detail across three-quarter, side, opposite-side, and low-angle inspection.
observations.comparison: The segmented S control shows visible torso and plate-boundary scarring under the same route while the continuous fitted-curve result remains visually continuous.
observations.residual: The strong S pose produces visible local stretch through the lower neck and anterior belly plates. It remains a bounded stress-assay residual rather than a global tear or piecewise binder scar.
observations.limbs: Attached limbs survive this whole-body deformation visually. Independent limb articulation, joint discovery, and locomotion transfer remain unproven by this assay.
